llm_response.reason: The website impersonates a gaming event, promising high-value in-game items with urgency (countdown timer), and asks for direct logins to social accounts (likely to steal credentials). There is no legitimate company contact or support, no privacy policy, ambiguous business identity, and all primary site methods fit scam patterns: unrealistic offers, phishing, and urgency. The domain and layout closely mimic common phishing and fake giveaway scams.
